_status: NEW 2026-08-13. China's second slice, and the round that takes this branch from ZERO edges to a connected fiscal chain. `cn-cpi-transfers.json` (BRICS/G.1) minted three real nodes but drew no dependencies at all, because every candidate target hit what was recorded as a genuine access wall. Two of those three walls were misdiagnoses -- see `_note` -- and the third finding (that the Budget Report cites nothing by name) turns out to be PARTLY WRONG: it does cite the Budget Law, operatively. Nine new nodes here, organised around the hub this round identified: 中华人民共和国预算法 (the Budget Law), which is cited by name and in operative voice by four separate documents in this corpus. The chain now runs central-to-provincial: the Budget Law is cited by the MOF's equalization-transfer measures (whose full 标准财政收入/标准财政支出 formula this round recovered verbatim, closing G.1's single biggest China blocker), by the annual Budget Report, by the annual central final accounts, and by a provincial instrument -- Ningxia's own equalization measures -- which cites BOTH the Budget Law AND the central 办法 by exact title in one sentence, and then replicates the central formula. That provincial-cites-central edge is the shape BRICS/G.1's own hand-off hoped a later round would find. This file also adds China's link into this project's supranational-influence objective: 中国国民经济核算体系（2016）states in its own text that it was revised to align with the UN's System of National Accounts 2008, giving a documented edge into the existing `sna-2008` node. Three deliberate NEGATIVES are recorded rather than forced -- the PBoC's Monetary Policy Report, the Government Work Report and the Budget Report all use CPI figures without ever naming the National Bureau of Statistics, each verified by exhaustive full-text scan rather than assumed.
_note: ACCESS AND VERIFICATION. Every source in this file is TIER A -- plain curl, genuine HTTP 200, real document bytes on a government host. No rendering proxy was used, because none was available: `r.jina.ai`, this project's standing TIER B fallback, is currently behind a Cloudflare challenge and returned HTTP 403 on every attempt. THREE ACCESS DIAGNOSES THAT OVERTURN ROUND 1, all reusable: (1) `yss.mof.gov.cn` returning 502 is NOT a blanket block. It is a per-path CDN failure, and the root page serves a real 19KB document body ALONGSIDE the 502 status -- so a status-code-only check reports the host dead when it is not. Deep paths on that subdomain do genuinely fail, but the same documents are served at TIER A from `www.mof.gov.cn/zhengwuxinxi/...`, `www.mof.gov.cn/gp/xxgkml/yss/...` and `www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/...`. (2) `npc.gov.cn` fails TLS with `sslv3 alert handshake failure` but works perfectly over PLAIN HTTP. This is NOT the trust-store gap the sibling Russia research found -- `openssl s_client` shows a valid re-signed chain -- it is a ClientHello rejection, a different failure with a different fix. (3) THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT ONE, and the reason G.1 could not find the equalization formula: the State Council policy-library notice page for the 均衡性转移支付办法 contains ONLY the covering letter in its HTML body. The 办法 itself, with every formula in it, is an UNLINKED-FROM-TEXT `.docx` ATTACHMENT. It was retrieved by fetching the attachment URL directly and extracting `word/document.xml` with python's `zipfile`. A session that reads only the rendered page will conclude, correctly and uselessly, that the formulas are not there. ONE FURTHER TRAP: the official government search API at `sousuo.www.gov.cn` returns HTTP 200 with populated results, but its RANKING IGNORES THE QUERY -- searches for 分税制财政管理体制的决定 returned unrelated 2023-2026 documents. It is unusable for discovery and its 200 status makes that easy to miss. HOST CAVEAT recorded honestly: 国发〔1993〕85号 was found as clean full TEXT (no OCR needed, superseding G.1's scanned-PDF-only conclusion) but only on a PROVINCIAL `.gov.cn` republication, not on a State-Council-operated host -- treat the text as reliable and the host as secondary. Every `basis` below is this session's own read of the underlying research.

reports.title: 中华人民共和国预算法 (Budget Law of the People's Republic of China)
reports.publisher: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会 (Standing Committee of the National People's Congress)
reports.description: China's foundational budget statute, and the hub of this entire slice -- four separate documents in this corpus cite it by name in operative voice, which is what promotes it from BRICS/G.1's `deferred` note to a node. Enactment and amendment history, verbatim from the NPC's own page header: 「（1994年3月22日第八届全国人民代表大会第二次会议通过　根据2014年8月31日第十二届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第十次会议《关于修改〈中华人民共和国预算法〉的决定》第一次修正　根据2018年12月29日第十三届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第七次会议《关于修改〈中华人民共和国产品质量法〉等五部法律的决定》第二次修正）」. Commencement, 第一百零一条: 「本法自1995年1月1日起施行。1991年10月21日国务院发布的《国家预算管理条例》同时废止。」 The transfer-payment article, 第十六条, quoted in full because it is the statutory basis the whole Chinese fiscal-transfer chain rests on: 「国家实行财政转移支付制度。财政转移支付应当规范、公平、公开，以推进地区间基本公共服务均等化为主要目标。财政转移支付包括中央对地方的转移支付和地方上级政府对下级政府的转移支付，以为均衡地区间基本财力、由下级政府统筹安排使用的一般性转移支付为主体。按照法律、行政法规和国务院的规定可以设立专项转移支付，用于办理特定事项。建立健全专项转移支付定期评估和退出机制。市场竞争机制能够有效调节的事项不得设立专项转移支付。上级政府在安排专项转移支付时，不得要求下级政府承担配套资金。但是，按照国务院的规定应当由上下级政府共同承担的事项除外。」 ("The State implements a fiscal transfer payment system … with equalisation of basic public services across regions as the principal objective … with general transfer payments — used to equalise basic fiscal capacity across regions and arranged at the discretion of the lower-level government — as the main body…"). Also load-bearing for the central/local architecture, 第六条: 「中央一般公共预算包括中央各部门（含直属单位，下同）的预算和中央对地方的税收返还、转移支付预算。…中央一般公共预算支出包括中央本级支出、中央对地方的税收返还和转移支付。」 Fetched TIER A over plain HTTP from the NPC's own portal (HTTPS fails on that host with a ClientHello rejection -- see `_note`); completeness verified by confirming the extracted text runs from 第一条 through 第一百零一条, all 101 articles across 11 chapters.
reports.cadence_note: A standing statute, amended rather than reissued (enacted 1994, first amended 2014, second amended 2018) -- the same convention this corpus applies to statutes elsewhere, e.g. `br-lc-62-1989` and `ru-subsistence-minimum-law-134fz`.

reports.title: 中央对地方均衡性转移支付办法 (财预〔2022〕58号) — Measures for Equalization Transfer Payments from the Central Government to Local Governments
reports.description: The document BRICS/G.1 recorded as its single biggest China blocker -- the instrument carrying the 标准财政收入 / 标准财政支出 (standard fiscal revenue / standard fiscal expenditure) formula. It was never behind the 502 wall G.1 diagnosed; it is a `.docx` attachment on a State Council policy-library page whose HTML body carries only the covering letter (see `_note`). Publication metadata verbatim from the page: 发文机关 财政部, 发文字号 财预〔2022〕58号, 成文日期 2022年04月13日, 公文种类 通知. It supersedes its own predecessor, 第十四条: 「本办法自发布之日起施行。《中央对地方均衡性转移支付办法》（财预〔2019〕108号）同时废止。」 A targeted check of MOF's own topic page for the series found no instrument superseding 财预〔2022〕58号 -- it is current. THE MASTER FORMULA, 第四条, verbatim: 「均衡性转移支付资金分配选取影响财政收支的客观因素，按照各地标准财政收入和标准财政支出差额及转移支付系数计算确定。其中，标准财政收入反映地方收入能力，根据工业增加值等因素及全国平均有效税率计算确定；标准财政支出旨在衡量地方支出需求，考虑人口规模、人口密度、海拔、温度、少数民族等成本差异计算确定。各地享受均衡性转移支付用公式表示为：某地区均衡性转移支付=(该地区标准财政支出-该地区标准财政收入)×该地区转移支付系数+增幅控制调整+省对下均等化努力程度奖励资金」. The eligibility rule, 第三条: 「中央财政按照测算办法，对标准财政支出大于标准财政收入的省、自治区、直辖市、计划单列市、新疆生产建设兵团（以下统称省）安排均衡性转移支付。」 The coefficient, 第七条: 「某省均衡性转移支付系数=（均衡性转移支付总额÷标准财政收支缺口总额）×权重+某省困难程度系数×权重…困难程度系数=标准化处理后（基本公共服务必保支出÷地方标准财政收入）×55%+标准化处理后（标准财政收支缺口÷标准财政支出）×45%」. The expenditure-side cost-difference coefficient, 第六条, is unusually granular, weighting population scale at 0.85 and area at 0.15 and then adjusting for remoteness, winter and summer temperature, altitude, road conditions, ethnic-minority status and poverty-alleviation status. The annual operating cycle is fixed by 第十一条: 「财政部于每年10月31日前，提前向省级财政部门下达下一年度均衡性转移支付预计数。」 ("Before 31 October each year, the Ministry of Finance shall issue in advance to provincial finance departments the estimated equalization transfer payment figures for the following year.") Fetched TIER A from `www.gov.cn`.
reports.cadence_note: A standing instrument, periodically revised (财预〔2019〕108号 superseded by 财预〔2022〕58号), which drives an ANNUAL allocation cycle stated in its own text: 「财政部于每年10月31日前，提前向省级财政部门下达下一年度均衡性转移支付预计数。」 `releases_per_year` is set to 1 for that annual cycle; the instrument itself is amended rather than reissued on a schedule.

reports.title: 自治区对市县均衡性转移支付办法 — Measures for Equalization Transfer Payments from the Autonomous Region to Cities and Counties (Ningxia)
reports.publisher: 宁夏回族自治区财政厅 (Department of Finance, Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region)
reports.description: A provincial-tier equalization instrument, and this round's best single find for China: it cites BOTH the Budget Law AND the central MOF measures by exact bracketed title, in one sentence, in its own operative first article -- exactly the provincial-document-citing-the-central-formula shape BRICS/G.1's hand-off hoped a later round would locate. 第一条, verbatim: 「为加快建立现代财政制度，建立权责清晰、财力协调、区域均衡的政府间财政关系，推进基本公共服务均等化，根据《中华人民共和国预算法》及《中央对地方均衡性转移支付办法》，特制定自治区对市县均衡性转移支付办法。」 ("…in accordance with the Budget Law of the People's Republic of China and the Measures for Equalization Transfer Payments from the Central Government to Local Governments, these Measures … are formulated.") The covering notice states it a second time: 「为进一步规范自治区对市县均衡性转移支付制度，推进基本公共服务均等化，根据《中央对地方均衡性转移支付办法》等有关规定，经报请自治区人民政府研究同意，自治区财政厅修订了…」 It does not merely cite the central method, it REPLICATES it, verbatim: 「某县标准收支缺口财力补助=（市县标准收入-市县标准支出）×补助系数」 -- structurally the same standard-revenue-minus-standard-expenditure-times-coefficient form as the central 第四条. Supersession, 第九条: 「本办法自印发之日起实行，《自治区对市县均衡性转移支付办法》(宁财预发〔2022〕544号)不再执行。」 Publisher byline verbatim: 「宁夏回族自治区财政厅　2023年11月4日」, 来源：预算处. Fetched TIER A from the Ningxia Department of Finance's own host. NOTE ON SELECTION: Guangdong and Sichuan equivalents were searched for as the more obvious large-province examples; Ningxia was the one that surfaced with a fetchable full text on a government host. A Guangdong instrument was located at `www.gd.gov.cn` but not fetched -- a clean lead for a future round wanting a second provincial instance.
reports.cadence_note: A standing provincial instrument, periodically revised rather than reissued on a cadence -- the 2023 measures replaced 宁财预发〔2022〕544号, mirroring the central instrument's own 2019-to-2022 revision pattern.

reports.title: 国务院关于实行分税制财政管理体制的决定 (国发〔1993〕85号) — Decision of the State Council on Implementing the Tax-Sharing Fiscal Management System
reports.description: The 1994 tax-sharing decision -- the foundational instrument of China's modern central-local fiscal relationship, and a document BRICS/G.1 could locate only as an un-OCR'd scan. A clean full-TEXT version exists and no OCR was needed; G.1's scanned-PDF-only conclusion is superseded. HOST CAVEAT, recorded honestly and repeated here because it matters: the only reachable full text is a republication on a PROVINCIAL `.gov.cn` host (the Health Commission of Jilin Province), not a State-Council-operated one; `www.gov.cn/gongbao/` and `www.gov.cn/zhengce/content/` were not successfully searched for it, partly because the official government search API is relevance-broken (see `_note`). The text is reliable, the host is secondary. Effective date, verbatim: 「国务院决定，从1994年1月1日起改革现行地方财政包干体制，对各省、自治区、直辖市以及计划单列市实行分税制财政管理体制。」 THE REVENUE SPLIT, 三、（二）, verbatim in the part that matters: 「中央与地方共享收入包括：增值税、资源税、证券交易税。增值税中央分享75%，地方分享25%。资源税按不同的资源品种划分，大部分资源税作为地方收入，海洋石油资源税作为中央收入。证券交易税，中央与地方各分享50%。」 -- shared revenues are VAT (75% central / 25% local), resource tax, and securities transaction tax (50/50), alongside enumerated fixed central revenues (customs duties, consumption tax, central enterprise income tax) and fixed local revenues (business tax, local enterprise income tax, individual income tax, property tax, stamp duty, deed tax, land VAT). THE TAX-REBATE FORMULA, 三、（三）, verbatim: 「中央财政对地方税收返还数额以1993年为基期年核定。…1993年中央净上划收入，全额返还地方，保证现有地方既得财力，并以此作为以后中央对地方税收返还基数。1994年以后，税收返还额在1993年基数上逐年递增，递增率按全国增值税和消费税的平均增长率的1：0．3系数确定，即上述两税全国平均每增长1%，中央财政对地方的税收返还增长0．3%。」 -- rebates are fixed on a 1993 base year and grow at a 1:0.3 coefficient against national VAT-plus-consumption-tax growth. The decision is also where the transfer-payment concept itself originates, 一、: 「科学核定地方收支数额，逐步实行比较规范的中央财政对地方的税收返还和转移支付制度；建立和健全分级预算制度，硬化各级预算约束。」 STILL OPERATIVE: the 税收返还 line item it created appears by name inside the 2022 equalization measures (第五条（二）: 「…税收返还及固定补助、体制结算补助等。」). NO EDGE was drawn from that overlap -- see `_dropped`; the later instrument names the MECHANISM, never the DOCUMENT.
reports.cadence_note: Not a recurring release -- a one-off standing foundational instrument, effective 1 January 1994, qualifying under this corpus's rule for standing instruments that define a method (here, the revenue split and the rebate escalation formula).

reports.title: 国务院关于2025年中央决算的报告 (Report of the State Council on the 2025 Central Final Accounts)
reports.publisher: 国务院 / 财政部 (State Council / Ministry of Finance)
reports.description: The executed counterpart to `cn-npc-budget-report` -- where the Budget Report is presented to the full NPC each March, the final accounts are delivered to the NPC Standing Committee each June. Byline verbatim: 「——2026年6月23日在第十四届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第二十三次会议上　财政部部长　蓝佛安　全国人民代表大会常务委员会：我受国务院委托，向全国人大常委会提出2025年中央决算报告和中央决算草案，请审查。」 It cites the Budget Law operatively as the authority for its accounting treatment: 「按照预算法和国务院有关规定，对2025年中央财政部分收支事项实行权责发生制核算，有关具体情况向全国人大常委会专门报告。」 ("In accordance with the Budget Law and relevant State Council provisions, certain central fiscal revenue and expenditure items for 2025 are accounted for on an accrual basis…"), corroborated twice more in compliance language: 「（六）坚持依法理财，自觉接受人大监督。深入贯彻预算法及其实施条例，严格落实全国人大批准的预算。」 and 「一是狠抓预算执行和政策落地。严格落实预算法等财经法律法规，加强财政支出管理。」 It also names the audit institution as a processing step: 「2025年中央一般公共预算、政府性基金预算、国有资本经营预算、社会保险基金预算的预算数、决算数及其对比分析，详见中央决算草案。草案已经审计署审计。」 ("The draft has been audited by the National Audit Office.") -- an agency-level reference with no corpus node to point at, recorded in `_dropped`. A full citation scan of the extracted text returned 3 hits for 预算法, 4 for 决算草案, and 0 for 国家统计局. Fetched TIER A from `www.mof.gov.cn`.
reports.cadence_note: Annual, delivered to the NPC Standing Committee each June -- evidenced by the year in the title and by the dated address line in the report's own byline («2026年6月23日在第十四届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第二十三次会议上»). Distinct in both timing and audience from the Budget Report, which goes to the full NPC session each March.

reports.title: 中华人民共和国国民经济和社会发展统计公报 (Statistical Communiqué of the People's Republic of China on National Economic and Social Development)
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics)
reports.description: NBS's flagship annual communiqué, and by a distance the richest source-attribution document located anywhere in the Chinese corpus -- it carries an explicit itemised 资料来源 (Sources) block naming roughly forty supplying bodies, each in the form "X data come from Y". Masthead verbatim: 「中华人民共和国2025年国民经济和社会发展统计公报[1]　国家统计局　2026年2月28日」. Data status, verbatim endnote [1]: 「本公报中数据均为初步统计数。各项统计数据均未包括香港特别行政区、澳门特别行政区和台湾省。部分数据因四舍五入的原因，存在总计与分项合计不等的情况。」 ("The data in this Communiqué are all preliminary statistics. All statistics exclude the Hong Kong SAR, the Macao SAR and Taiwan Province…"). The sources block, extract verbatim: 「资料来源：本公报中城镇新增就业、养老保险、失业保险、工伤保险、中等职业教育中的技工学校数据来自人力资源和社会保障部；外汇储备、汇率数据来自国家外汇管理局；…货物进出口数据来自海关总署；…财政数据来自财政部；减税降费及退税数据来自国家税务总局；货币金融、公司信用类债券数据来自中国人民银行；…其他数据均来自国家统计局。」 An internal note additionally pins the vintage of its fiscal figures to MOF final accounts rather than to budget figures: 「注：图中2021年至2024年数据为全国一般公共预算收入决算数，2025年为执行数。」 ("figures for 2021-2024 in the chart are final-account figures for national general public budget revenue; 2025 is the execution figure") -- which is what lets one of this file's edges point at the final-accounts node specifically rather than at the Ministry of Finance generically. The remaining ~18 attributions in the block all name ministries and agencies without titled publications and are recorded in `_dropped` rather than forced into edges. Fetched TIER A from `www.stats.gov.cn`; extracted text 56,213 characters including all 90 endnotes.
reports.cadence_note: Annual, published in late February for the preceding year (the 2025 communiqué is dated 2026年2月28日). Evidenced by NBS's own standing annual series index at `https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/tjgb/ndtjgb/qgndtjgb/index.html` (全国年度统计公报) and by the year-in-title convention.

reports.title: 中国国民经济核算体系（2016） (China's System of National Economic Accounting (2016)), 国统字〔2017〕115号
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics)
reports.description: China's standing national-accounts methodological system, and this file's contribution to the project's documented-supranational-influence objective set out in REPORTS.md: it states in its own text that it was revised specifically to align with the United Nations' System of National Accounts 2008. Verbatim: 「2009年，联合国等五大国际组织颁布了国民经济核算新的国际标准——《国民账户体系2008》（以下简称2008年SNA）。目前，绝大部分发达国家和部分发展中国家已经开始执行2008年SNA。我国国民经济核算体系也需要做出相应的修订，使之与新的国际标准相衔接，提高国际可比性。」 ("In 2009, the United Nations and four other major international organisations promulgated the new international standard for national economic accounting — the System of National Accounts 2008 … China's national economic accounting system also needs to be revised accordingly, so as to align with the new international standard and improve international comparability.") The operative opening clause states the same intent constitutively: 「为加强和改进宏观经济调控…实现与国民经济核算新的国际标准相衔接，按照党的十八届三中全会关于加快建立国家统一的经济核算制度的要求，我国对中国国民经济核算体系进行了全面系统的修订。」 Publication metadata verbatim: 文号 「国统字〔2017〕115号」, publisher line 「国家统计局　2017年7月13日」. It also cites its own State Council authorisation by document number -- 「根据《国务院关于中国国民经济核算体系（2016）的批复》（国函〔2017〕91号）精神，现将《中国国民经济核算体系（2016）》…印发给你们，请认真贯彻落实。」 -- a named instrument that was not fetched this round and is recorded as a lead in `_dropped`. Fetched TIER A from `www.stats.gov.cn`.
reports.cadence_note: A standing methodological instrument, revised generationally rather than on a cadence (the 2002 system was superseded by the 2016 system, promulgated by 国统字〔2017〕115号 in July 2017).

reports.title: 中华人民共和国统计法 (Statistics Law of the People's Republic of China)
reports.publisher: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会 (Standing Committee of the National People's Congress)
reports.description: The standing statute that assigns China's statistical standard-setting authority, in its 2024 revision. 第一条 verbatim: 「为了科学、有效地组织统计工作，保障统计资料的真实性、准确性、完整性和及时性，加强统计监督，发挥统计在了解国情国力、服务经济社会高质量发展中的重要作用，推动全面建设社会主义现代化国家，制定本法。」 The methodological hook, 第十九条: 「国家制定统一的统计标准，保障统计调查采用的指标涵义、计算方法、分类目录、调查表式和统计编码等的标准化。国家统计标准由国家统计局制定，或者由国家统计局和国务院标准化主管部门共同制定。」 ("The State formulates unified statistical standards … National statistical standards are formulated by the NBS, or jointly by the NBS and the standardisation authority of the State Council.") And the national-accounts mandate that underpins `cn-nbs-national-accounts-system-2016`, 第二十条: 「国家实施统一的国民经济核算制度。国家统计局统一组织和实施地区生产总值核算工作。」 ("The State implements a unified system of national economic accounting. The NBS uniformly organises and implements the accounting of gross regional product.") MINTED WITHOUT EDGES, deliberately and with the negative recorded: this round specifically tested whether NBS's monthly CPI release cites a statutory basis and found that it does not -- see `_dropped`. The statute is a real, verified, load-bearing instrument and is minted on that basis, in line with the observation in BRICS/G.1's own hand-off that an opening round's nodes often precede the edges that will later connect them. Fetched TIER A from `www.stats.gov.cn`.
reports.cadence_note: A standing statute, amended rather than reissued; this is the 2024 revision.

reports.title: 中国货币政策执行报告 (China Monetary Policy Report)
reports.publisher: 中国人民银行货币政策分析小组 (Monetary Policy Analysis Group, People's Bank of China)
reports.description: The PBoC's quarterly monetary-policy report -- minted as a node, and notable in this corpus chiefly for a NEGATIVE that this round verified exhaustively rather than assumed. Cover byline verbatim: 「中国人民银行货币政策分析小组　2026年5月11日」. The report uses consumer price data throughout -- 「（三）居民消费价格涨幅扩大，生产价格连续回升。居民消费价格涨幅继续扩大。一季度，居民消费价格（CPI）同比涨幅为0.8%，比上季度提高0.2个百分点，月度涨幅分别为0.2%、1.3%和1.0%。…扣除食品和能源的核心CPI同比上涨1.2%…」 -- but NEVER ATTRIBUTES IT. A whitespace-stripped full-text search across all 55 pages, run twice (plain `pdftotext` and `pdftotext -layout`), returned 0 hits for 国家统计局, 0 for 统计局 and 0 for 海关总署, while all 17 occurrences of 数据来源 ("data source") resolve to 中国人民银行 or 中国货币网 and none to NBS. The dependency plainly exists in substance -- the PBoC cannot have computed the CPI itself -- but the document's own text does not name it, and under this project's evidence standard that means no edge. See `_dropped`. Fetched TIER A from `www.pbc.gov.cn`; the PDF carries a real text layer (99,241 characters extracted), so no OCR was involved.
reports.cadence_note: Quarterly. Evidenced by the edition title itself (「2026年第一季度」) and by the PBoC's own series index at `https://www.pbc.gov.cn/goutongjiaoliu/113456/113469/`, which lists one report per quarter.

dependencies.basis: VERIFIED DIRECTLY, TIER A. The measures name the Budget Law in their own constitutive first article: 「为加快建立现代财政制度，建立权责清晰、财力协调、区域均衡的中央和地方财政关系，推进基本公共服务均等化，根据《中华人民共和国预算法》及其实施条例，制定《中央对地方均衡性转移支付办法》。」 ("…in accordance with the Budget Law of the People's Republic of China and its Implementing Regulations, these Measures … are formulated.") Corroborated a second time in 第十三条: 「依照《中华人民共和国预算法》及其实施条例、《财政违法行为处罚处分条例》等国家有关规定追究相应责任。」 TENSE: 「根据 … 制定」 is present and constitutive, not a past-tense acknowledgement -- unambiguous. `cites` rather than `methodology_depends_on`: the Budget Law establishes the transfer-payment system and its equalisation objective (第十六条) but supplies no calculation method; every formula in this chain is the measures' own. That is the same distinction `br-ipca-fpe.json` draws when typing `br-fpe-dn-tcu -> br-lei-8443` as `cites` while typing the formula statute as `methodology_depends_on`.

VERIFIED DIRECTLY, and a correction to BRICS/G.1, which recorded that the Budget Report cites no document by name. It does cite the Budget Law, operatively -- this is the legal authority for spending before the NPC has approved the budget, not decorative compliance language: 「根据预算法规定，预算年度开始后，在全国人民代表大会批准本预算草案前，可安排下列支出：上一年度结转的支出；参照上一年同期的预算支出数额安排必须支付的本年度部门基本支出、项目支出，以及对下级政府的转移性支出；法律规定必须履行支付义务的支出，以及用于自然灾害等突发事件处理的支出。根据上述规定，结合中央部门和地方实际支出需要，中央财政安排了部分本级支出及对地方转移支付。」 ("In accordance with the provisions of the Budget Law, after the budget year begins and before the NPC approves this draft budget, the following expenditures may be arranged: … In accordance with the above provisions … the central finance authority has arranged part of its own-level expenditure and transfer payments to localities.") Corroborated in weaker compliance voice: 「认真落实预算法和人大预算审查监督有关要求」 and 「坚持预算法定，硬化预算约束，进一步全面深入实施好预算法」. A literal regex scan of the full extracted report text returned 4 hits for 预算法. TENSE: present and operative. NOTE that G.1's finding was only PARTLY wrong -- the same scan returned 0 hits for 国发, 0 for 办法 and 0 for 国家统计局, so its conclusions about the tax-sharing decision, the equalization measures and NBS all stand (see `_dropped`).

VERIFIED DIRECTLY, TIER A. The final-accounts report names the Budget Law as the authority for its accounting treatment, which is operative rather than decorative: 「按照预算法和国务院有关规定，对2025年中央财政部分收支事项实行权责发生制核算，有关具体情况向全国人大常委会专门报告。」 ("In accordance with the Budget Law and relevant State Council provisions, certain central fiscal revenue and expenditure items for 2025 are accounted for on an accrual basis, with the specific circumstances reported separately to the NPC Standing Committee.") Corroborated twice: 「深入贯彻预算法及其实施条例，严格落实全国人大批准的预算。」 and 「严格落实预算法等财经法律法规，加强财政支出管理。」 A citation scan of the full text returned 3 hits for 预算法. `cites` rather than `methodology_depends_on`: the accrual treatment is authorised by the law jointly with unspecified State Council provisions, and the law is not quoted as supplying the accounting method itself.

VERIFIED DIRECTLY, and the strongest single edge found for China this round. Ningxia's own first article names the central measures by exact bracketed title: 「为加快建立现代财政制度…推进基本公共服务均等化，根据《中华人民共和国预算法》及《中央对地方均衡性转移支付办法》，特制定自治区对市县均衡性转移支付办法。」 Restated in the covering notice: 「根据《中央对地方均衡性转移支付办法》等有关规定，经报请自治区人民政府研究同意，自治区财政厅修订了…」 `methodology_depends_on` rather than `cites`, because the provincial instrument does not merely reference the central one -- it REPLICATES its formula: Ningxia's own 「某县标准收支缺口财力补助=（市县标准收入-市县标准支出）×补助系数」 is structurally the central 第四条's standard-expenditure-minus-standard-revenue-times-coefficient form, re-expressed one tier down. That is genuine method inheritance, the same distinction `br-ipca-fpe.json` uses to type `br-fpe-dn-tcu -> br-lc-62-1989` as `methodology_depends_on`. TENSE: 「根据 … 特制定」 is present and constitutive.

VERIFIED DIRECTLY, from the same single sentence as the edge above -- Ningxia's 第一条 names both instruments together: 「…根据《中华人民共和国预算法》及《中央对地方均衡性转移支付办法》，特制定自治区对市县均衡性转移支付办法。」 `cites` rather than `methodology_depends_on` for the same reason as the central measures' own edge to the Budget Law: the statute establishes the transfer-payment system and its equalisation objective but supplies no calculation method. Worth recording that this makes the Budget Law's authority visible at two tiers of government from documents' own text, which is the shape this corpus exists to draw.

VERIFIED DIRECTLY, and a documented instance of the supranational-to-national dependency REPORTS.md's own secondary objective is looking for -- a national statistical system stating, in its own text, that it was revised to conform to an international standard. Verbatim: 「2009年，联合国等五大国际组织颁布了国民经济核算新的国际标准——《国民账户体系2008》（以下简称2008年SNA）。目前，绝大部分发达国家和部分发展中国家已经开始执行2008年SNA。我国国民经济核算体系也需要做出相应的修订，使之与新的国际标准相衔接，提高国际可比性。」 ("In 2009, the United Nations and four other major international organisations promulgated the new international standard for national economic accounting — the System of National Accounts 2008 … China's national economic accounting system also needs to be revised accordingly, so as to align with the new international standard and improve international comparability.") The operative clause repeats the intent constitutively: 「实现与国民经济核算新的国际标准相衔接…我国对中国国民经济核算体系进行了全面系统的修订。」 TENSE NOTE, flagged because the sentence mixes them: the promulgation of the 2008 SNA is described in the past, but the alignment is stated in present-constitutive voice (「使之与新的国际标准相衔接」 — "so as to align it with the new international standard"), and the revision it justifies is the instrument being issued. The edge is sound on the alignment clause, not on the historical one. Unlike most China edges this round, the target is named by exact title AND edition year, so there is no version ambiguity of the kind that blocked the COICOP edge (see `_dropped`).

_dropped.edge: cn-nbs-cpi -> un-coicop-2018 (or un-coicop-hbs-1999) — the UN classification the CPI basket is built against
_dropped.why: A real, verbatim, primary-source citation of COICOP that nevertheless cannot become an edge, because it names no EDITION and this corpus carries two. NBS's own CPI methodology page states: 「具体来说，国家统计局参照联合国统计委员会《按目的划分的个人消费支出分类标准（COICOP）》及我国《居民消费支出分类》，结合全国城乡居民家庭消费支出的抽样调查资料，统一确定了"篮子"中所包含的商品和服务类别，分别是食品烟酒、衣着、居住、生活用品及服务、交通通信、教育文化娱乐、医疗保健、其他用品及服务共8个大类，268个基本分类。」 ("the NBS, referring to the UN Statistical Commission's Classification of Individual Consumption According to Purpose (COICOP) and China's own Classification of Resident Consumption Expenditure … has uniformly determined the categories … 8 major categories and 268 basic classes"). The corpus holds `un-coicop-2018` and `un-coicop-hbs-1999`; pointing at either would assert an edition the source does not state. Two further reasons for caution, recorded so a future session does not simply overrule this: the citation says 参照 ("with reference to") rather than a conformity claim, and China's 8 major categories do not map one-to-one onto COICOP's divisions, so the relationship is looser than the AF-branch cases where a national office states COICOP 2018 conformity outright. RESOLVABLE CHEAPLY: 《居民消费价格调查方案》 or 《居民消费支出分类》 would very likely name the edition. Note also the scoping question flagged by the research and left unresolved here: this methodology page may be the same source BRICS/G.1 folded into `cn-nbs-cpi`'s own description, in which case these are edges out of the existing node; if a future round decides it is separable, a `cn-nbs-cpi-methodology` node would be the cleaner home for both this and the household-survey citation below.

_dropped.edge: cn-nbs-cpi -> 全国住户收支与生活状况调查 (the NBS household survey supplying the CPI weights)
_dropped.why: A named, real input with no node to point at. NBS's CPI methodology page states it verbatim: 「在编制全国CPI时，权数资料主要根据国家统计局开展的全国住户收支与生活状况调查中城乡居民家庭消费支出资料计算，同时用其他部门的行政资料、部分典型调查和专项调查资料予以补充，并辅以专家评估进行完善。」 ("The weight data are calculated primarily from urban and rural household consumption expenditure data in the National Household Income, Expenditure and Living Conditions Survey conducted by the NBS…"). The survey is named by title but was not located as a published release this round. Worth noting the exact structural parallel in the sibling Russia slice, where Приказ Росстата № 915 names «выборочное обследование бюджетов домашних хозяйств» as its CPI weights source and hits the same wall -- two BRICS statistical offices, the same dependency shape, the same missing node.

_dropped.edge: cn-nbs-cpi -> cn-statistics-law (or any titled statutory instrument governing the CPI)
_dropped.why: NOT FOUND, tested directly rather than assumed. The monthly CPI release's own 附注 (explanatory notes) are complete and genuinely methodological -- they set out the indicator definition, the 8大类/268个基本分类 scope, and the sampling design 「数据来源于全国31个省（区、市）约500个市县、近12万家价格调查点」 -- but they name no statute and no titled instrument anywhere. The only quasi-citation is the bare, untitled phrase 「按照统计制度安排」 ("in accordance with the arrangements of the statistical system"), used to introduce the 2025 base-period rotation. That is not a document citation and no edge is drawn from it. `cn-statistics-law` is minted in this file on its own merits and is currently unconnected, which is the honest state of the evidence. DATING INCONSISTENCY worth flagging for a future round: the NBS methodology page states 「根据调查方案规定，每五年更换一次"篮子"，本轮CPI的"篮子"固定在2020年」 while the July 2026 release states the base period rotated to 2025 from January 2026 -- the two NBS pages disagree, and the release is the more recent.

_dropped.edge: cn-mof-equalization-transfer-measures -> 国家统计局 / 统计年鉴 (the NBS data behind standard fiscal revenue)
_dropped.why: AGENCY ONLY, and a class-level publication reference -- two near misses in the same instrument, neither pointing at a titled release. The agency-level citation, 第五条（一）3.: 「个人所得税标准财政收入（地方分享部分）。按照税目分别计算。其中，工资薪金所得税税基采用国家统计局提供的各地在岗职工平均工资、各地区就业人数、各地城镇居民人均可支配收入等，税率按照全国平均有效税率分类计算确定；」 ("the tax base for wage-and-salary income tax uses, as provided by the National Bureau of Statistics, each locality's average wage of employed staff, each region's number of employed persons, and each locality's per-capita disposable income of urban residents"). The class-level one, 第十条, which comes closer but stops short of a title: 「均衡性转移支付测算所需资料原则上来源于统计年鉴等公开资料和相关部门提供的数据。」 ("The materials required for calculating equalization transfer payments shall in principle come from statistical yearbooks and other publicly available materials, and from data provided by the relevant departments.") The three named series (在岗职工平均工资, 就业人数, 城镇居民人均可支配收入) are all carried in the China Statistical Yearbook and in `cn-nbs-statistical-communique`, so the natural target exists in substance -- but 「统计年鉴等」 ("statistical yearbooks etc.") is a class, not a title, and the corpus has no China Statistical Yearbook node. Minting one and re-testing this edge is a clean, high-value lead: it would connect China's fiscal chain to its statistical chain, which is currently the branch's main structural gap.

_dropped.edge: cn-nbs-statistical-communique -> 财政部 / 中国人民银行 / ~18 further ministries (the itemised 资料来源 block)
_dropped.why: AGENCY ONLY, in bulk -- the richest attribution block found anywhere in the Chinese corpus, and none of it edge-qualifying as it stands. Every clause takes the form "X数据来自Y" naming a ministry rather than a publication: 「财政数据来自财政部」, 「货币金融、公司信用类债券数据来自中国人民银行」, 「货物进出口数据来自海关总署」, 「减税降费及退税数据来自国家税务总局」, and roughly eighteen more (人力资源和社会保障部, 国家外汇管理局, 商务部, 教育部, 中国气象局, 应急管理部, 国家医疗保障局, 民政部, 国家金融监督管理总局, 中国证券监督管理委员会, 自然资源部, 生态环境部, 农业农村部, 交通运输部, 工业和信息化部, 住房和城乡建设部, 国家知识产权局), closing with 「其他数据均来自国家统计局。」 ONE OF THESE IS ALMOST RESCUABLE and is the best lead in this entry: the communiqué's own chart note pins the vintage of its fiscal figures to final accounts rather than to budget figures -- 「注：图中2021年至2024年数据为全国一般公共预算收入决算数，2025年为执行数。」 -- which points at `cn-mof-central-final-accounts` specifically rather than at the Ministry of Finance generically. It was NOT minted because the 资料来源 clause and the chart note are separate statements and joining them is inference, not citation: the note explains a chart's vintage, it does not say the communiqué draws its fiscal data from the final-accounts REPORT. A future round that finds either statement made in one breath gets the edge immediately.

NOT FOUND, and BRICS/G.1's finding on this point is CONFIRMED CORRECT rather than overturned. A literal regex scan of the full extracted Budget Report text returned 0 hits for 办法 and 0 for 财预 -- it never names the equalization measures, by title or by document number. It reports only the outcome: 「均衡性转移支付安排28340亿元、增长3.7%」 (equalization transfers of RMB 2.834 trillion, +3.7%). A figure produced by a formula is not a citation of the instrument carrying the formula, and no edge is drawn from the numeric relationship. Recorded explicitly because this round DID overturn G.1's neighbouring claim that the report cites nothing at all -- it cites the Budget Law -- and the two findings must not be collapsed into one another.

_dropped.edge: cn-npc-budget-report -> cn-statecouncil-tax-sharing-decision-1993, and any edge at all into the 1993 decision
_dropped.why: NOT FOUND in either direction, confirming BRICS/G.1. The Budget Report's full text returned 0 hits for 国发. More interestingly, the 2022 equalization measures do NOT cite it either, despite operating the mechanism it created: 第五条（二） lists 「…税收返还及固定补助、体制结算补助等。」 as a component of standard fiscal revenue, so the 1993 decision's tax-rebate line item is still live by name thirty-two years on -- but the later instrument names the MECHANISM, never the DOCUMENT. NO EDGE MAY BE DRAWN ON MECHANISM-NAME OVERLAP; that is precisely the "comparable with"-shaped inference this project's evidence standard exists to refuse. The node is minted as a genuine standing instrument with, so far, no documented inbound dependency -- an honest and slightly striking result for what is generally treated as the foundational document of Chinese fiscal federalism.

NOT FOUND, and this was the round's single most-hoped-for China edge, tested to destruction before being abandoned. A whitespace-stripped full-text search across all 55 pages of the Q1 2026 report, run twice with different extraction settings (`pdftotext` and `pdftotext -layout`), returned 0 hits for 国家统计局, 0 for 统计局 and 0 for 海关总署. All 17 occurrences of 数据来源 ("data source") in the document resolve to 中国人民银行 or 中国货币网; not one names NBS. The report nonetheless uses CPI heavily and unattributed -- 9 hits for CPI and 3 for 居民消费价格, e.g. 「一季度，居民消费价格（CPI）同比涨幅为0.8%，比上季度提高0.2个百分点」. The dependency exists in substance and cannot not exist; the document simply does not state it. This is the same shape as the Bank of Russia's key-rate releases in `ru-g2-rosstat-equalization.json`, which likewise never name Rosstat -- a recurring BRICS pattern worth watching: central banks in this branch treat the national statistical office's output as ambient fact rather than as a cited source, which is exactly the case a citation-based graph cannot represent.

NOT FOUND, re-tested this round against the authoritative State Council Gazette text and confirming BRICS/G.1. Scan results over 20,624 extracted characters: 国家统计局 0 hits, 统计局 0 hits, and only 3 generic hits for 统计 (「完善统计、财税、考核等制度」, 「碳排放统计核算」, 「加强财会监督和统计监督」), none naming NBS or any statistical publication. The CPI target is stated with no attribution whatever: 「今年发展主要预期目标是：经济增长4.5%—5%…居民消费价格涨幅2%左右」 and 「居民消费价格涨幅2%左右，考虑了预期引导和现实可能，我们将通过改善总供求关系，推动价格总水平由负转正、消费价格合理温和回升，促进经济良性循环。」 The report does cite two documents by exact title -- 《中共中央关于制定国民经济和社会发展第十五个五年规划的建议》 and 《中华人民共和国国民经济和社会发展第十五个五年规划纲要（草案）》 -- but these are Party and national-plan instruments rather than recurring statistical or fiscal publications, and are noted here rather than pursued.

NOT FOUND, judged too weak rather than merely unlocated. The final-accounts report is by construction the executed counterpart to the budget the Budget Report presents, and it does refer to 「十四届全国人大三次会议审查批准的预算」 ("the budget examined and approved by the third session of the 14th NPC") -- but that names the BUDGET INSTRUMENT approved by the legislature, not the REPORT DOCUMENT this corpus carries as `cn-npc-budget-report`. A scan for 预算草案的报告 as a titled citation returned 0 hits. The distinction is exactly the one this project's scope rule turns on -- a node is a document, and a reference to the thing a document describes is not a reference to the document -- so no edge is drawn.

AGENCY ONLY. The final-accounts report names the audit institution as a processing step its own draft passed through: 「2025年中央一般公共预算、政府性基金预算、国有资本经营预算、社会保险基金预算的预算数、决算数及其对比分析，详见中央决算草案。草案已经审计署审计。」 ("…see the draft central final accounts. The draft has been audited by the National Audit Office.") It names an agency and an act of auditing, not a titled audit publication, and the corpus has no 审计署 node. The National Audit Office publishes a recurring annual audit report on central budget execution which would be a strong node in its own right and would likely close this -- a clean lead for a future China round, and one that would give this branch its accountability tier, which the AF and EU branches both have.

_dropped.edge: 《中华人民共和国2025年全国预算执行情况2026年全国预算（草案）》 as a node (the Budget Report's detail annex)
_dropped.why: Cited TWICE by exact bracketed title in the Budget Report as the place the underlying detail lives -- 「以上预算执行的具体情况及相关说明见《中华人民共和国2025年全国预算执行情况2026年全国预算（草案）》。」 and 「预算具体安排及相关说明见《中华人民共和国2025年全国预算执行情况2026年全国预算（草案）》。」 -- and an annually published companion volume, so it would qualify as a recurrent node. No free-standing URL was located this round; the volume is tabled at the NPC session rather than published as a discrete web document. Not minted, because this corpus requires a node to have a URL of its own rather than existing solely on the strength of a citing document. This is the best-evidenced missing node in the Chinese corpus: the citation is exact, doubled, and by title.

_dropped.edge: 《居民消费价格调查方案》 and 国函〔2017〕91号 as nodes
_dropped.why: Two instruments named by exact title in documents this file mints, neither retrievable this round. (1) 《居民消费价格调查方案》 (Consumer Price Survey Scheme) is named as the governing instrument for the CPI's scope and calculation method: 「中国CPI编制工作由国家统计局组织实施。国家统计局负责全国CPI的编制及相关工作，制定《居民消费价格调查方案》，对CPI的统计范围、计算方法、统计口径和填报目录等作出统一规定…」. It could not be fetched; the related 流通消费价格调查制度 page returned a hard 404 (555 bytes). Finding it would give `cn-nbs-cpi` the governing-instrument edge that the monthly release's bare 「按照统计制度安排」 cannot support. (2) 国函〔2017〕91号, the State Council reply approving the 2016 national accounting system, is cited by number inside that system's own promulgation notice: 「根据《国务院关于中国国民经济核算体系（2016）的批复》（国函〔2017〕91号）精神…」. Not fetched this round.
